observations: Photo 0: Top view of a closed HP laptop with a visible HP logo on the lid. The laptop is placed on a wooden surface. A second laptop is partially visible in the foreground, open and angled, showing its side ports.
Photo 1: Front view of a closed HP laptop with the HP logo centered on the lid. The laptop has silver hinges and is placed on a wooden surface. A white cabinet is in the background.

Photo 2: Front view of an open HP laptop showing the screen, keyboard, and touchpad. The screen is off and has visible smudges and fingerprints. The keyboard has a black layout with white lettering. The HP logo is visible below the screen. The word 'ProBook' is visible on the lower left of the keyboard deck. An Intel logo sticker is visible on the lower right of the palm rest. The laptop is placed on a wooden surface.

claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows 'ProBook' on the keyboard deck, and the seller's words specify the model. The design matches known ProBook 450 G3 models.
No CPU sticker or system information visible. The Intel logo sticker in photo 2 does not specify the generation or model.
RAM cannot be verified from photos. No system information or open chassis shown.
No drive bay or system information visible. Cannot confirm storage type or size from photos.
Screen is off in photo 2. No OS interface visible. Cannot confirm operating system.

risks.risk: The laptop may not be a ProBook 450 G3 or may have been rebranded.
risks.proof: A clear shot of the model label on the bottom of the laptop or inside the lid.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic HP laptop, not a ProBook 450 G3.

risks.risk: The CPU may not be a 6th gen Core i5.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the system information (e.g., from Windows 'About' or CPU-Z) or a clear shot of the CPU sticker inside the laptop.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic Intel laptop, not a 6th gen Core i5.

risks.risk: RAM may be less than 8GB or not functional.
risks.proof: A screenshot of the system information showing installed RAM or a video of the laptop booting with RAM test.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having 4GB RAM or less, or as not working.

risks.risk: Storage may not be 500GB HDD or may be faulty.
risks.proof: A screenshot of disk management or a video showing the drive being accessed and its size.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having a smaller or unknown storage capacity, or as not working.

risks.risk: The laptop may not have Windows 10 or may be non-functional.
risks.proof: A video of the laptop booting and showing the Windows 10 desktop or a screenshot of the OS.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working or with unknown OS.

risks.risk: Screen may be cracked or have dead pixels.
risks.proof: A video of the screen displaying a solid color or a full-screen test pattern.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having a damaged screen.

risks.risk: Keyboard or touchpad may be faulty.
risks.proof: A video of the keyboard and touchpad being used.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as having non-functional input devices.

proof_requests: A clear photo of the model label on the bottom of the laptop.
A screenshot or video of the system information showing CPU, RAM, and storage details.
A video of the laptop booting and showing the Windows 10 desktop.
A video of the screen displaying a solid color or test pattern.
A video of the keyboard and touchpad being used.
response.reason: The model is supported by the 'ProBook' text on the keyboard deck, but key specifications (CPU, RAM, storage, OS) cannot be verified from the photos. Hidden risks include incorrect model, faulty components, and non-functional state. Proof is needed to confirm the claims and assess the true condition.
